The included checker independently verifies rational algebra and selected recurrence/onset instances; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source motivates stiff damping and long-time use of the optimized method. The exact 15/16 crossing yields a qualitative collapse of robustly positive initial-history sets, despite unconditional linear stability. The nontrivial 1/(s-15/16) hitting-time law and explicit constant quantify delayed sign failure that finite integration tests may overlook. This is a natural structural and quantitative limitation, not a parameter-renaming or one-off low-dimensional sign example.
